units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|name|124|0
units.english: Deploy Quarg Scanners
units.italian: Deploy Quarg Scanners

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|description|125|0
units.english: Head to each of the marked systems to deploy the Quarg scanning satellites, then head to <destination> to collect your payment.
units.italian: Dirigetevi verso ciascuno dei sistemi segnalati per dispiegare i satelliti di scansione Quarg, poi andate su <destination> a ritirare il pagamento.

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|A Quarg slowly makes its way to you when it notices you in the spaceport. "Greetings, human friend. Would you happen to have the time to listen to a proposal? We are looking for a pilot willing to help us deploy some scanning satellites."|141|0
units.english: A Quarg slowly makes its way to you when it notices you in the spaceport. "Greetings, human friend. Would you happen to have the time to listen to a proposal? We are looking for a pilot willing to help us deploy some scanning satellites."
units.italian: Un Quarg si avvicina lentamente quando vi nota nello spazioporto. "Salute, amico umano. Avresti per caso il tempo di ascoltare una proposta? Cerchiamo un pilota disposto ad aiutarci a dispiegare alcuni satelliti di scansione."

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	"Sure, where am I deploying them?"|143|0
units.english: "Sure, where am I deploying them?"
units.italian: "Certo, dove li dispiego?"

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	"What are the satellites for?"|145|0
units.english: "What are the satellites for?"
units.italian: "A che servono i satelliti?"

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	"I don't have the time, no."|146|0
units.english: "I don't have the time, no."
units.italian: "Non ho tempo, no."

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	"To help humans in the other end of this region, the South, be better prepared against incoming attacks, and help them keep track of ships that pass by their systems."|148|0
units.english: "To help humans in the other end of this region, the South, be better prepared against incoming attacks, and help them keep track of ships that pass by their systems."
units.italian: "Per aiutare gli umani dall'altra parte di questa regione, a Sud, a essere meglio preparati contro gli attacchi in arrivo, e ad aiutarli a tenere traccia delle navi che passano per i loro sistemi."

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	"I'd like to help with that then. Where am I deploying them?"|150|0
units.english: "I'd like to help with that then. Where am I deploying them?"
units.italian: "Allora mi piacerebbe aiutare. Dove li dispiego?"

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	"Help? Why do you want to help people there all of a sudden?"|152|0
units.english: "Help? Why do you want to help people there all of a sudden?"
units.italian: "Aiutare? Perché volete aiutare la gente laggiù all'improvviso?"

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	"I am actually headed to a different part of the galaxy now, sorry."|153|0
units.english: "I am actually headed to a different part of the galaxy now, sorry."
units.italian: "In realtà adesso sono diretto in un'altra parte della galassia, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	"Why?" It pauses for a second. "Surely you have seen the foolish thugs that plague this whole region. We can deal with them here, but we do not usually travel far. To promote peace all around, without even more needless slaughter, providing some measures to deter further attacks is but a courtesy."|155|0
units.english: "Why?" It pauses for a second. "Surely you have seen the foolish thugs that plague this whole region. We can deal with them here, but we do not usually travel far. To promote peace all around, without even more needless slaughter, providing some measures to deter further attacks is but a courtesy."
units.italian: "Perché?" Si ferma un secondo. "Di certo avrai visto gli stolti teppisti che infestano tutta questa regione. Qui possiamo occuparcene noi, ma di solito non viaggiamo lontano. Per promuovere la pace dappertutto, senza un altro inutile massacro, fornire qualche misura che scoraggi ulteriori attacchi è solo una cortesia."

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	"I'd like to help with that then. Where am I deploying them?"|157|0
units.english: "I'd like to help with that then. Where am I deploying them?"
units.italian: "Allora mi piacerebbe aiutare. Dove li dispiego?"

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	"I am actually headed to a different part of the galaxy now, sorry."|158|0
units.english: "I am actually headed to a different part of the galaxy now, sorry."
units.italian: "In realtà adesso sono diretto in un'altra parte della galassia, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	"To <waypoints>. Once you are done, return here and you will receive <payment>."|161|0
units.english: "To <waypoints>. Once you are done, return here and you will receive <payment>."
units.italian: "Su <waypoints>. Quando avrai finito, torna qui e riceverai <payment>."

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|	As soon as you arrive at your ship, you find various Quarg with loaderbots, putting the four satellites inside your ship's cargo hold. The satellites are shaped like triangular pyramids, with each point of the main pyramid being tipped with another, smaller triangular pyramid. You can't quite make it out from this distance, but you wonder if the smaller pyramids are also tipped with even smaller pyramids. Each of the devices is roughly half your size, but probably weigh a lot more than you.|162|0
units.english: As soon as you arrive at your ship, you find various Quarg with loaderbots, putting the four satellites inside your ship's cargo hold. The satellites are shaped like triangular pyramids, with each point of the main pyramid being tipped with another, smaller triangular pyramid. You can't quite make it out from this distance, but you wonder if the smaller pyramids are also tipped with even smaller pyramids. Each of the devices is roughly half your size, but probably weigh a lot more than you.
units.italian: Appena arrivate alla vostra nave, trovate vari Quarg con robot caricatori che infilano i quattro satelliti nella stiva. I satelliti hanno la forma di piramidi triangolari, e ogni punta della piramide principale è sormontata da un'altra piramide triangolare più piccola. Da questa distanza non riuscite a distinguerlo bene, ma vi chiedete se anche le piramidi più piccole siano sormontate da piramidi ancora più piccole. Ognuno dei dispositivi è all'incirca grande la metà di voi, ma probabilmente pesa molto più di voi.

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|dialog|165|0
units.english: You open your cargo hold, and let a Quarg scanner drift out to the void.
units.italian: Aprite la stiva e lasciate che uno scanner Quarg esca alla deriva nel vuoto.

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|dialog|167|0
units.english: Looking at the former slave-colony planet here as you deploy their scanner, you wonder if the Quarg heard about Poisonwood's history, and that's why they decided to help with surveillance.
units.italian: Guardando il pianeta che fu colonia di schiavi mentre dispiegate il loro scanner, vi chiedete se i Quarg abbiano saputo della storia di Poisonwood, e se sia per questo che hanno deciso di aiutare con la sorveglianza.

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|dialog|169|0
units.english: You set a Quarg scanner free, and let it leave your ship.
units.italian: Liberate uno scanner Quarg e lo lasciate andare via dalla nave.

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|dialog|171|0
units.english: Although those that live on the planet here don't seem to mind the occasional pirates demanding tribute, maybe they will come to appreciate the reduced pirate presence here, assuming the Quarg scanner really does help with that.
units.italian: Sebbene chi vive sul pianeta qui non sembri preoccuparsi dei pirati che ogni tanto chiedono un tributo, forse arriveranno ad apprezzare la presenza pirata ridotta, ammesso che lo scanner Quarg serva davvero a questo.

units.id: mission:Quarg Satellites|dialog|176|0
units.english: You land to find a Quarg waiting right at the docks. It hands you <payment>, and thanks you for your help.
units.italian: Atterrate e trovate un Quarg che vi aspetta proprio sulla banchina. Vi consegna <payment> e vi ringrazia per l'aiuto.

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|name|182|0
units.english: Human Construction Materials
units.italian: Human Construction Materials

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|description|183|0
units.english: Head to <stopovers> to pick up <cargo>, then bring it all to <destination>, where the Quarg are preparing to open the first section of their ringworld for human visitors.
units.italian: Andate su <stopovers> a ritirare <cargo>, poi portate tutto su <destination>, dove i Quarg si preparano ad aprire ai visitatori umani la prima sezione del loro mondo ad anello.

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|In the spaceport, a group of Quarg is talking to dozens of human captains. Some nod and head right back to their ships, while a few others remain and appear to discuss a bit more with the Quarg.|196|0
units.english: In the spaceport, a group of Quarg is talking to dozens of human captains. Some nod and head right back to their ships, while a few others remain and appear to discuss a bit more with the Quarg.
units.italian: Nello spazioporto un gruppo di Quarg sta parlando con decine di capitani umani. Alcuni annuiscono e tornano subito alle loro navi, mentre pochi altri restano e sembrano discutere ancora un po' con i Quarg.

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	(Join them to see what's going on.)|198|0
units.english: (Join them to see what's going on.)
units.italian: (Unitevi a loro per vedere cosa succede.)

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	(Ignore them.)|199|0
units.english: (Ignore them.)
units.italian: (Ignorateli.)

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	You join the group, and one of the Quarg diverts its attention to you, while the others continue speaking with the human merchants.|201|0
units.english: You join the group, and one of the Quarg diverts its attention to you, while the others continue speaking with the human merchants.
units.italian: Vi unite al gruppo, e uno dei Quarg rivolge la sua attenzione a voi, mentre gli altri continuano a parlare con i mercanti umani.

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	"Would you also be someone willing to provide us a cargo service, Captain?" it asks, all the while checking a data pad, which seems to be related to the ships docked here. "Not many of you humans in this region have the cargo space required, much less proper defenses for cargo convoys. We are willing to pay adequately for whoever meets the criteria and is willing to help us."|202|0
units.english: "Would you also be someone willing to provide us a cargo service, Captain?" it asks, all the while checking a data pad, which seems to be related to the ships docked here. "Not many of you humans in this region have the cargo space required, much less proper defenses for cargo convoys. We are willing to pay adequately for whoever meets the criteria and is willing to help us."
units.italian: "Anche tu saresti qualcuno disposto a fornirci un servizio di trasporto merci, Capitano?" chiede, continuando intanto a controllare un datapad che sembra riguardare le navi attraccate qui. "Non molti di voi umani in questa regione hanno lo spazio di carico necessario, e ancor meno difese adeguate per i convogli merci. Siamo disposti a pagare adeguatamente chi soddisfa i criteri ed è disposto ad aiutarci."

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	"Are those other Captains also doing this? What do you need so much cargo for?"|204|0
units.english: "Are those other Captains also doing this? What do you need so much cargo for?"
units.italian: "Anche gli altri capitani lo stanno facendo? Perché vi serve tanto carico?"

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	"I'm not looking for any more cargo jobs right now, sorry."|205|0
units.english: "I'm not looking for any more cargo jobs right now, sorry."
units.italian: "Non cerco altri lavori di trasporto adesso, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	"Many have agreed to help us already, but we still need many more. Those that have agreed to help are headed all to different portions of human space, to safely bring us the materials we have ordered.|207|0
units.english: "Many have agreed to help us already, but we still need many more. Those that have agreed to help are headed all to different portions of human space, to safely bring us the materials we have ordered.
units.italian: "Molti hanno già accettato di aiutarci, ma ne servono molti altri. Quelli che hanno accettato sono diretti in parti diverse dello spazio umano, per portarci in sicurezza i materiali che abbiamo ordinato.

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	"Our ringworld, under construction around the star of <system>, is to have a special open section for humans to visit soon. We wish to make the internal style and decoration of that section closer to human standards, so we are asking every capable captain to help. You are one such captain, are you willing to help us?"|208|0
units.english: "Our ringworld, under construction around the star of <system>, is to have a special open section for humans to visit soon. We wish to make the internal style and decoration of that section closer to human standards, so we are asking every capable captain to help. You are one such captain, are you willing to help us?"
units.italian: "Il nostro mondo ad anello, in costruzione intorno alla stella di <system>, avrà presto una sezione speciale aperta ai visitatori umani. Vorremmo che lo stile e l'arredamento interno di quella sezione fossero più vicini agli standard umani, quindi chiediamo a ogni capitano capace di aiutarci. Tu sei uno di questi capitani: sei disposto ad aiutarci?"

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	"Alright, I'm interested. Where should I go to pick up the cargo?"|210|0
units.english: "Alright, I'm interested. Where should I go to pick up the cargo?"
units.italian: "Va bene, mi interessa. Dove devo andare a ritirare il carico?"

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	"Sorry, I'm not looking for any cargo job right now, I was just curious."|211|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not looking for any cargo job right now, I was just curious."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non cerco lavori di trasporto adesso, ero solo curioso."

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	It fiddles with the data pad a bit more, then says, "You are to pick up <cargo> on <stopovers>, then deliver that cargo to <destination>. You will be paid <payment> for the service. Be well, human."|213|0
units.english: It fiddles with the data pad a bit more, then says, "You are to pick up <cargo> on <stopovers>, then deliver that cargo to <destination>. You will be paid <payment> for the service. Be well, human."
units.italian: Armeggia ancora un po' con il datapad, poi dice: "Devi ritirare <cargo> su <stopovers>, poi consegnare quel carico su <destination>. Sarai pagato <payment> per il servizio. Stammi bene, umano."

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	It gestures a bow to you, then leaves to speak with another merchant captain that got curious as well.|214|0
units.english: It gestures a bow to you, then leaves to speak with another merchant captain that got curious as well.
units.italian: Vi fa un inchino con un gesto, poi si allontana a parlare con un altro capitano mercantile che è diventato curioso anche lui.

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|dialog|217|0
units.english: The <cargo> is loaded into your ship under strict supervision, each crate carefully accounted for.
units.italian: Il <cargo> viene caricato sulla vostra nave sotto stretta sorveglianza, ogni cassa accuratamente contata.

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|Much like your own ship, several other human freighters and convoys are arriving, and the cargo being meticulously checked by the Quarg, as they use their own machinery to unload what must be tens of thousands of tons from all the ships.|223|0
units.english: Much like your own ship, several other human freighters and convoys are arriving, and the cargo being meticulously checked by the Quarg, as they use their own machinery to unload what must be tens of thousands of tons from all the ships.
units.italian: Proprio come la vostra nave, diversi altri mercantili umani e convogli stanno arrivando, e il carico viene meticolosamente controllato dai Quarg, che usano i propri macchinari per scaricare quello che devono essere decine di migliaia di tonnellate da tutte le navi.

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo|	About halfway through the unloading of your own cargo, a Quarg comes up to you and hands you <payment>.|224|0
units.english: About halfway through the unloading of your own cargo, a Quarg comes up to you and hands you <payment>.
units.italian: A metà circa dello scarico del vostro carico, un Quarg si avvicina e vi consegna <payment>.

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo Job|name|228|0
units.english: Human Construction Materials
units.italian: Human Construction Materials

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo Job|description|229|0
units.english: Head to <stopovers> to pick up <cargo>, then bring it all to <destination>, where the Quarg are preparing to open the first section of their ringworld for human visitors.
units.italian: Andate su <stopovers> a ritirare <cargo>, poi portate tutto su <destination>, dove i Quarg si preparano ad aprire ai visitatori umani la prima sezione del loro mondo ad anello.

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo Job|dialog|244|0
units.english: The <cargo> is loaded into your ship under strict supervision, each crate carefully accounted for.
units.italian: Il <cargo> viene caricato sulla vostra nave sotto stretta sorveglianza, ogni cassa accuratamente contata.

units.id: mission:Lagrange Ring: Cargo Job|dialog|249|0
units.english: About halfway through the meticulous unloading of the cargo, a Quarg comes up to you and hands you <payment>.
units.italian: A metà circa del meticoloso scarico del carico, un Quarg si avvicina e vi consegna <payment>.
